passage.title: Model paragraph written for TGA
paras: Both poets present time as a force that tests human feeling, although Shakespeare defies it while Lawrence surrenders to it. [P] Shakespeare insists 'Love's not Time's fool', whereas Lawrence admits that memory 'Betrays me back'. [E] Shakespeare personifies Time as a master that true love can ignore; Lawrence's verb 'Betrays' makes memory a traitor inside him. [M] One speaker stands firm; the other is carried away. [A] Both poems suggest that what we love shapes how we experience time. [C] Ultimately, Sonnet 116 offers certainty, but Piano's honesty about grief may feel truer to many readers. [S]
